worked_solution:
We need to solve the equation $Ax=0.$ First, we find the row echelon form of $A$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}3 & 6 \\ 6 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=\frac{1}{3}{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 6 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+(-6){R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

This corresponds to the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=0 \\ 0=0\end{aligned}
$$

The basic variables are the variables whose coefficients are pivots. In this case, the basic variable is ${x}_{1}$, and we have one free variable, ${x}_{2}.$ That means we need to find ${x}_{1}$ in terms of ${x}_{2}.$

From the first equation we get ${x}_{1}=-2{x}_{2},$ so the set of all the solutions of $Ax=0$ is

$$
\text{Null}(A)={[\begin{aligned}-2{x}_{2} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]\,:\,{x}_{2}\in R}.
$$
